div.head: V Atr 32.2
div.ab: ⁊ oðer is, þæt gewitnessa ne moston standan, þeah hi fulgetreowe wæron ⁊ hi swa sædan, swa hi to woldon swerian.
⁊ oðer is, þæt gewitnessa ne moston standan, þeah hi fulgetreowe wæron ⁊ hi swa sædan swa hi to woldon swerian. [D only]
Secondly, that the testimony of witnesses was not allowed to be valid, although they were thoroughly trustworthy and were willing to swear to [the truth of] their statements.
Und das zweite ist, dass Zeugen nicht gelten durften, obwohl sie voll vertrauenswürdig waren und sie so aussagten, wie sie darauf schwören wollten.
And the second is that witnesses were not allowed to stand, although they were fully trustworthy and declared as they were willing to swear.
div.note: Only in D. Liebermann compares III Atr 2, 1 f.
